card.name: Start of a word split in pieces
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that is split into parts, such as 'pos' in posaconazole, 'Abs' in Absorption, 'Sh' in Shaking and 'pres' in preservative. Seen in drug-label text.

modes.label: Start of common label words
modes.description: The opening piece of ordinary words like Absorption, Shaking, preservative or shelling.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated word pieces, so there is no clear output effect beyond favoring a word continuation.
